cases.description: Attacker deposits 1 ETH and withdraws 6 ETH, consuming the victim's 5 ETH in the local EVM.
The same callback attack receives only its own deposit in the checks-effects-interactions remediation fixture.
A rejecting recipient causes withdrawal to revert and retains its credit in the remediation fixture.
Fuzz deposit amounts and callback counts; remediation fixture must preserve victim funds and credit.
